key_terms.الْفَارِقَاتِ: The distinct ones / those who separate

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Al-Fariqat' mean in Surah Al-Mujadila?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Mujadila (58:1), the phrase 'Al-Fariqat' (the Separators) specifically denotes women who initiate separation from their husbands, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the Khula' divorce mechanism. This verse establishes the legal precedent for women seeking dissolution of marriage, emphasizing the procedural distinction and the subsequent waiting period ('Iddah') to ensure clarity in lineage and social status.
